apps.name: PulseMonitor
apps.description: Real-time CPU, GPU, RAM, disk and network monitoring in a clean desktop overlay. Always visible, never in the way.

apps.name: SweptPC
apps.description: Scan and remove junk files, browser cache, temp files and more in one click. Free and fully portable.

apps.name: FileFlow
apps.description: Preview, organise and safely undo file moves. See every move before it happens; existing files are never overwritten.

apps.name: BatteryVault
apps.description: Laptop battery health at a glance: wear, charge cycles, live charge rate and time remaining, right from the tray. Currently in beta.

apps.name: WaveScout
apps.description: Free portable Wi-Fi analyser for Windows. Scan nearby networks, check signal strength, find the best channel and monitor your connection live.

apps.name: ScribeVault
apps.description: Turn interviews, meetings and dictation into text on your own PC. Nothing is uploaded: ScribeVault itself never opens a network connection. Free trial; £49 licence coming soon.

apps.name: VaultSoft Hub
apps.description: One portable launcher for VaultSoft apps. Install, update and run them from a single window.

hub_promo.text: Run a UK trade business? Automate your Google review requests with StarPing.
